reviewInformation.title: When you will hear from us
reviewInformation.text: We aim to respond within 14 working days. This is a review target, not a guaranteed deadline; some projects may take longer.

reviewInformation.title: How we review
reviewInformation.text: We listen to the submitted work and consider its context, rights, credits and the support you are seeking. Share links you have permission to send. The first submission does not require masters, identity documents, banking details or a Studio account.

reviewInformation.title: Partnerships and Studio
reviewInformation.text: If there is a fit, we discuss Silver, Gold or Platinum based on the agreed scope of support, not an artist ranking. Silver includes Studio; Gold and Platinum include Studio Pro under the partnership terms. An enquiry, streaming-profile selection or proposed tier does not activate a subscription or create an agreement.

reviewInformation.title: What happens next
reviewInformation.text: An accepted proposal moves to account verification and a separate partnership review and agreement. Any release, services and commercial terms must be confirmed before work begins. Submitting this form does not publish music, sign a contract or charge a fee.

artistDiscovery.title: Find your artist profile (optional)
artistDiscovery.description: Enter your artist name to search connected music platforms, then select your profile. No releases yet? Continue with your name and any listening link below. Selecting a profile does not verify ownership.
artistDiscovery.privacy: Search sends the artist name you enter to connected platforms. Portraits appear only where supplied by the platform; initials indicate that no photo was supplied. No album cover is used as an artist photo.

form.privacy: Artanrecords uses the details you submit to review your work and respond to your enquiry.

submissionPrivacy.title: Submission privacy
submissionPrivacy.description: How Artanrecords handles artist enquiries and submitted work.

sections.title: Your enquiry
sections.text: Artanrecords uses your name, contact details, introduction and submitted links to review your work and respond. Sending an enquiry does not publish a profile or create an offer of representation.

sections.title: Processing and storage
sections.text: Artist submissions pass through our Supabase service to the existing Google service for verification, private Google Sheet storage and an email notification to our collaboration inbox, hosted by iCloud. A signed server-to-server handoff records artist enquiries in the shared Artan Supabase backend for authorized Artanrecords reviewers in Control Center. If that handoff temporarily fails, the saved Sheet row remains pending for retry. Contact enquiries use the existing Google form service directly. Applications and review notes are never added to the public website repository.

sections.title: Optional artist search
sections.text: Searching sends the artist name you enter to connected streaming platforms through our search service. Search results and selected profile links are listening references, not proof of identity or ownership. Selected platform names, artist names, identifiers and links are included with your submission; provider portraits are displayed only where supplied and are not copied into your artist profile. You can skip search and enter your name and a listening link manually.

sections.title: Verification
sections.text: Opening the form loads Google reCAPTCHA to help prevent spam and abuse. It processes browser and interaction information and uses a necessary verification cookie. Verification is required before an enquiry can be accepted.

sections.title: What to share
sections.text: Share listening links, not private masters, project files or sensitive documents. Include only work and information you have permission to share.

sections.title: Retention and requests
sections.text: Closed enquiries are removed from the active enquiry sheet by a daily cleanup once 30 days have elapsed after their recorded Declined or Closed status. Active conversations and legacy rows without a recorded closure date are not eligible. Notification emails and provider-held history require separate review; this is not a promise of automatic deletion from every provider. You can request access, correction or deletion by contacting collaborate@artanrecords.com. Do not send additional sensitive documents with your request.

sections.title: External services
sections.text: Google processes verification and form data, and iCloud hosts the notification inbox. Their own privacy notices apply to their services. This notice describes the current enquiry process; project-specific data handling is agreed separately.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.text: You can contact Artanrecords by email instead of using the form. Sending an enquiry does not subscribe you to marketing or create an artist account. Include only information relevant to the work and obtain permission before sharing another person's private details. Requests about previously submitted information are reviewed individually.

sections.title: Contact
sections.text: Artanrecords is an independent label founded by Artan Davoodi and is not currently a registered company. For enquiry privacy questions, contact collaborate@artanrecords.com.

channels.title: The music comes first
channels.description: Send your artist name, a short introduction and a listening link. Singles, EPs and albums can begin here. We listen and review enquiries individually: this is a conversation, not automatic distribution.
channels.detail: Share links, not private masters or project files.

channels.title: A clear next step, together
channels.description: If there is a fit, we discuss your project, credits, artwork and release plans. The scope, responsibilities and commercial terms must be agreed before an engagement begins.
channels.detail: Submission is not acceptance. Promotion is not automatically included.

channels.title: Beyond the recording
channels.description: Sound and image belong in the same conversation. We welcome creative collaborators alongside recording artists. Share a portfolio and tell us what you would like to make together.
channels.detail: Artists, musicians and visual collaborators are welcome.
